parent_objective: generate a broader no-training extreme-fault coverage discovery wave

public_gates: run is no-training no-PPO no-promotion with actor checksum unchanged
summary reports scenario_count snapshot_count matched_pair_count accepted/reset/wrong rows
fault-family and severity summaries are written
current-model proxy and future-only fidelity boundaries are preserved
result class determines whether to export source rows, return to actor-head objective design, or design higher-fidelity dynamics
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add fault labels hidden params or oracle labels to actor observations
do not claim proxy faults are faithful single-wheel physics
do not tune thresholds after seeing the full run without registering a new manifest

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_scenario_coverage: full v2 extreme-fault discovery data wave
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: runs the registered v2 fault coverage corpus and classifies whether broader extreme coverage creates wrong-history action/outcome-critical rows
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: no-training scenario-discovery evidence only; no actor capability promotion or PPO claim
stop_condition: stop current-model coverage branch if v2 remains reset-only or history-insensitive
stop source export if wrong-history action-critical rows fail diversity thresholds
stop fidelity claims for true wheel-asymmetric faults in the single-track model
fallback_plan: if cross_fault_wrong_positive, design source-balanced export and proof/generalization gates
if action or feature positive but outcome negative, return to actor-head residual objective design with v2 rows
if reset-only, audit whether delayed-history or active warm-up is missing before model upgrade
if model_fidelity_blocked, design four-wheel or external-yaw-disturbance dynamics extension

hypothesis: The v2 extreme-fault coverage wave will expose more matched-history-sensitive cases than M704/M707 by broadening fault families, severity levels, surprise activations, and current-model proxy combinations.
success_criteria: failure taxonomy and next blocker are documented
failure_criteria: runner fails to load the v2 config
actor inputs or observation shape change
run claims true wheel-asymmetric physics from current-model proxies
run omits fault-family and severity summaries
implementation promotes a checkpoint or admits PPO

commands.name: full_v2_data_wave
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.extreme_dynamics_scenario_corpus --checkpoint runs/m568_scaled_l3_bc_seed5660/checkpoint.pt --config configs/extreme_fault_coverage_v2_scenarios.json --pairing-mode cross_fault --seed-start 72000 --seed-count 512 --device cpu --run-dir runs/m716_extreme_fault_coverage_refresh

decision_rule: M716 may admit source export only if wrong-history action-critical rows pass the v2 diversity gates. It may not admit PPO or promotion directly.
